name: la1bg
style: Flat 2D illustration, a wide double-page spread from a children's picture book. {subject} No black outlines: shapes are flat colour fills only, every colour with a slightly darker flat shade for simple two-tone shading. Bright cheerful colours, clean simple shapes, lots of calm open space. No text, no letters, no numbers.

items.bg: A flat side view of a sunny peaceful island like a stage set seen straight from the front with no perspective, with NO animals and NO people: a pale blue sky with a few soft white clouds, calm blue sea far in the back on the right with a few dark grey sea rocks, green forest covered hills on the left, a few tropical trees at the left and right edges, and a wide flat green meadow with some round rocks across the whole bottom half of the picture.
